title: SGD spec frontmatter — regulatory traceability extension
description: OPTIONAL `regulatory:` block added to an SGD feature-spec frontmatter by /sgd:regulatory-trace. Absent => unregulated spec (no obligation). Required (per C12) for any spec whose governing capability is `regulated: true`. Complements, never replaces, the AI use-case register (`ai-inventory.yaml`).

fca_obligations.description: Catalogue ids this spec helps the CLIENT evidence. Each id MUST exist in obligations-catalogue.yaml and MUST NOT be retired.

contribution.description: How this spec contributes evidence — evidence-contribution, NOT a compliance assertion.

frameworks.description: Certification-framework controls this spec implements evidence for.

consumer_duty.description: Does this spec's output reach or inform a retail-customer outcome (PRIN 2A)?

tripartite_evidence.description: May this spec's evidence be disclosed to a client's external auditor and/or the regulator under FG26/4 access rights?

ai_inventory_ref.description: Link to the AI use-case register entry when this spec is an AI use case. Link, do NOT duplicate SS1/23 / Annex III fields.
